$comment: Behavior case specifications for the IT document skill. Developer-only, never shipped. Fixture text is synthetic and contains no real address, credential or personal data. Static checks validate structure and fixture integrity only; every behavior result is NOT_RUN until an authorized evaluation grades real transcripts.

cases.request: Fix the grammar in this paragraph. Do not rename anything.
cases.input: The OrderSync service read the table dbo.Order_Header and publish the result to queue orders.v2 every night.

mustNot: add an actor or schedule not in the source
checks: Grammar is corrected (reads, publishes) without changing any identifier
The nightly schedule stays as stated and is not turned into a verified scheduler

cases.request: Tighten the wording of this requirement.
cases.input: The database server has 16 GB of memory, a 500 GB data volume and a connection timeout of 30 seconds.

checks: Every number and unit appears unchanged in the result

cases.request: Make this section read more naturally.
cases.input: The service MUST reject expired tokens. It SHOULD log each rejection and MAY return a retry hint. It MUST NOT expose the token value.

preserve: MUST NOT expose the token value
mustNot: change the strength of an obligation
checks: MUST, SHOULD, MAY and MUST NOT keep their strength
The prohibition is not reworded as advice

cases.request: Write the server inventory section from the notes below.
cases.input: Notes: Two application servers run the web tier in the production environment. No sizing, operating system or hostname information was supplied.

mustNot: invent a CPU, memory, operating system, hostname or address
checks: Missing values are listed as Missing Information or Requires Clarification
The section contains no invented specification

cases.request: Audit docs/design.md for missing sections and unsupported claims.
cases.input: Section 5 states that all traffic is encrypted and that the service recovers automatically within five minutes. No evidence was supplied.

mustNot: report an unsupported claim as an error without evidence
checks: Findings carry location, evidence, status and a recommended action
The document is unchanged after the run

cases.input: Evidence: the design brief says a standby site is planned. The deployment configuration lists one production site. The document says the system fails over to the standby site.

flag: fails over to the standby site
mustNot: accept a planned capability as deployed
checks: The statement is reported as intended design, not as a verified capability
The conflicting sources are named

cases.request: Compare the two documents and the API contract.
cases.input: Application Design section 3.2 names the endpoint /api/orders. Infrastructure Design section 4.1 routes /api/order. The OpenAPI file defines /api/orders.

mustNot: pick a value without evidence or owner approval
checks: Both locations are reported with the evidence
The OpenAPI file is shown as supporting one side, with the decision left to the owner

cases.request: Update only section 6.2 for the new export format.
cases.input: Document uses numbered headings 6.1 to 6.4 and a three-column interface table. Section 6.2 describes a CSV export. The new implementation exports JSON.

checks: Only 6.2 changes
Numbering, headings and table structure are kept
The change summary lists 6.2 as Modified with its evidence

cases.request: Update the design document to match the new code.
cases.input: An existing docs/design.md written by the user. The user did not say the file may be overwritten.

mustNot: change revision history without being asked
checks: The run asks before overwriting the named file, or writes to a new file
No commit or push occurs

cases.request: Review the language of this design document. The repository is open for reference.
cases.input: The repository contains a controller whose behavior differs from one sentence in the document.

mustNot: edit the repository to match the document
checks: The mismatch is reported as a finding
No source file changed

cases.request: Update this reused document for the customized system.
cases.input: The baseline document says the system integrates with a payment gateway over port 8443. The customized implementation has no gateway configuration and a new invoice export.

mustNot: assume the original configuration applies to the customized system
checks: The gateway statement is marked Not Verified or Removed for owner confirmation
The invoice export is classified as New with its evidence

cases.request: Fix the English in this sentence.
cases.input: The data will be send to another system every day.

mustNot: state that the application is the actor
checks: The grammar is fixed
The actor and schedule are not verified unless supported by evidence, and the missing actor is raised as a question

cases.request: Rewrite the landing page headline so it sounds less like marketing boilerplate.
cases.input: Landing page copy for a product.

checks: This skill does not apply; ordinary marketing and blog copy goes to the English editorial skill

cases.input: The network diagram is dated two releases ago. The current firewall rule export lists an additional communication flow on port 5671.

mustNot: treat the older diagram as authoritative
checks: Source freshness is noted
The additional flow is reported as a gap in the document
